Introduction

Jaehyuk is a Korean singer under YG Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group TREASURE.

Jaehyuk debuted as a member of TREASURE on August 7, 2020 with the single album, The First Step: Chapter One.

On June 15, 2023, Jaehyuk was confirmed as the fourth member of TREASURE's sub-unit T5.
